王凝之妻謝氏 is a descriptive kinship reference to the wife of Wang Ningzhi, surnamed Xie. The annotation context mentions 太傅 (Grand Tutor, i.e., Xie An) and 桓玄, and the annotation explicitly identifies this person as 謝道韞 (Xie Daoyun), who was indeed Wang Ningzhi's wife and Xie An's niece. The alias registry evidence directly supports this identification. The annotation text '問王凝之妻謝氏曰太傅' places her in a context where she is asked about the Grand Tutor (her uncle Xie An), consistent with the historical record.

安石 is the courtesy name of 謝安 (Xie An). The alias registry evidence explicitly states '謝安字安石' (Xie An, courtesy name Anshi). In the main text, 安石 appears in the phrase '諸人毎相與言安石不肻出' where people discuss Anshi not being willing to come out of seclusion — this directly matches the story context where Xie An is in seclusion at Dongshan. The coreference with 謝公 and 謝 in the same passage is contextually clear. No contradicting evidence.

The context makes this unambiguous: Gao Ling is teasing Xie An about repeatedly refusing court appointments while in seclusion at Dongshan. The coreference with 謝公 and 安石 in the same passage is clear. The alias registry evidence for 安石 (Xie An's courtesy name) supports the identification through the shared context. No contradicting evidence.

assertions.interpretation: Xie An was residing at Dongshan, a period of seclusion before his later official career.
Repeated imperial summons were issued but Xie An did not respond, describing the period of his refusal to serve.
Later, Xie An came out of seclusion to serve as Sima under Huan Xuanwu (Huan Wen), marking a chronological transition after his Dongshan period.
The scene is set at the moment when Xie An was about to depart from Xinting, the immediate temporal context of the story.
At that time, all the court officials came out to see him off, concurrent with the departure scene.
Gao Ling was serving as Zhongcheng (Censor-in-Chief) at that time, providing the official role context for the scene.
Gao Ling also went to offer a farewell banquet, concurrent with the departure event.
Prior to the scene, Gao Ling had drunk some wine, establishing a preceding state that explains his feigned drunkenness.
Gao Ling then leaned as if drunk and joked, occurring at the moment of the farewell gathering.
